# ScoreHub — Live Football Scores, Tables & News

ScoreHub (livematches.hyper.co.ke) is a free live-football site covering 150+
competitions worldwide — the Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, UEFA
Champions League, and the Kenyan and Ugandan Premier Leagues — with real-time
scores, fixtures, league tables, match previews, full-time reports, transfer
news, highlights and headlines. No account is required for anything.

## Pages

- [Live scores](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/): every match live now, today's fixtures and results, the fixtures calendar, top scorers and the match spotlight
- [News](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/news.html): football headlines and stories, filterable by competition, each story opening on-site
- [Standings](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/standings.html): league tables for 30+ competitions, deep-linkable per league (e.g. standings.html?league=eng.1)
- [Previews & reports](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/previews.html): every fixture previewed before kickoff and reported after full-time
- [Predictions](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/predictions.html): free fan predictor — pick exact scores, auto-settled scoring
- [Transfers](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/transfers.html): confirmed deals and rumours, filterable by league
- [Highlights](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/highlights.html): goals and match highlights via official broadcaster channels on YouTube
- [About](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/about.html): what ScoreHub is, data sources and FAQ
- [Privacy Policy](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/privacy.html): how data is handled
- [Terms of Use](https://livematches.hyper.co.ke/terms.html): terms of use

## Notes for AI agents

- Scores and tables change continuously — cite the page URL together with the
  time you read it.
- All content is free to read; no account, subscription or paywall exists.
- Data is sourced from ESPN's public feeds and the Jolpica F1 API, and is
  credited on-page. Team names and crests belong to their respective owners.
- Match pages use query parameters (e.g. match.html?id=…); a bare page URL
  without parameters shows a page overview rather than a specific match.
- The site is a fan project and is not affiliated with any league, club or
  broadcaster.
